comparison_note: This is a controlled MPNet versus MiniLM comparison: both models use local SentenceTransformer snapshots, the same ESCO labels, the same reviewed spans, and the same lexicon-first ranking procedure.
description: Replace all-mpnet-base-v2 with all-MiniLM-L6-v2 in the ESCO ranker
interpretation: Positive deltas indicate that MiniLM outperformed MPNet; negative deltas indicate a decrease. Both models were loaded from local SentenceTransformer snapshots and evaluated on the same 1404 URI-mapped spans with the same lexicon-first ranking procedure. FAISS was unavailable on this macOS host, so both models use the mathematically equivalent NumPy exact inner-product index.
